markers.interpretation: MTHFR C677T converts 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate to 5-methyltetrahydrofolate (active folate). Homozygous T/T reduces pathway efficiency by up to 70%, which can lead to elevated homocysteine if folate intake is inadequate.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Enzymatic reduction is easily bypassed with dietary folate or methylfolate; genotype does not dictate clinical status if cofactor intake is optimal.

sources.name: Homocysteine and MTHFR C677T Meta-Analysis
sources.notes: Establishes quantitative impact of C677T on serum homocysteine concentrations.

markers.interpretation: MTHFR A1298C (G allele) causes a minor decrease in enzyme activity. Heterozygous C677T combined with A1298C (compound heterozygosity) decreases folate conversion by 40-50%, affecting one-carbon metabolism.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: A1298C has minimal clinical impact on its own unless paired with a C677T allele.

sources.name: MTHFR A1298C and disease association studies
sources.notes: Determines that A1298C is not a risk factor for neural tube defects unless present in compound heterozygosity.

markers.interpretation: IL-6 is a key inflammatory cytokine. The G allele is linked to elevated baseline IL-6 secretion, which can influence systemic inflammatory tone and transient mood/cognitive sensitivity during immune activation.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Cytokine expression is dynamic and highly dependent on body composition, physical fitness, sleep, and chronic infectious loads.

sources.name: IL-6 promoter polymorphism and baseline inflammation
sources.notes: Details transcription rate differences of -174G vs C promoter variants.

markers.interpretation: TNF-alpha is a master inflammatory cytokine. The rs1800629 A allele increases promoter transcription activity, linked to elevated TNF-alpha production and systemic baseline inflammatory susceptibility.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Baseline inflammatory markers are driven by diet, visceral fat volume, dental health, and gut barrier integrity.

sources.name: TNF-alpha promoter polymorphism and transcriptional activation
sources.notes: Shows elevated transcription levels of the -308A variant in reporter gene assays.

markers.impact: Impaired iron clearance / elevated ferritin (Hemochromatosis risk)
markers.interpretation: The HFE C282Y A allele prevents proper cell-surface expression of HFE, leading to unrestrained iron absorption. Homozygotes are at high risk of hereditary hemochromatosis, characterized by iron overload in organs.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Clinical penetrance is low; many homozygotes do not develop clinical symptoms of iron overload without secondary factors.

sources.name: EASL Guidelines on Hemochromatosis
sources.notes: Recommends genetic testing for individuals with unexplained iron overload.

markers.impact: Impaired iron clearance / elevated ferritin (Hemochromatosis risk)
markers.interpretation: H63D (G allele) is a milder modifier than C282Y. Compound heterozygosity (C282Y/H63D) can cause minor to moderate iron overload, while homozygous H63D/H63D rarely leads to severe clinical symptoms on its own.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Array assays read this variant reliably, but actual iron toxicity is diagnostic-lab based.

sources.name: HFE H63D mutation and clinical penetrance
sources.notes: Establishes that H63D homozygosity has very low clinical penetrance.

markers.impact: Altered methionine synthase activity / one-carbon methylation
markers.interpretation: MTR encodes methionine synthase, which transfers a methyl group from folate to B12, then to homocysteine. The G allele is linked to minor enzyme velocity changes; verify B12/homocysteine status before supplementing.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: MTR operates in close feedback loops with MTRR; single-gene status is non-predictive.

sources.name: MTR A2756G polymorphism and homocysteine levels
sources.notes: Examines interaction of MTR genotypes with B12 levels.

markers.impact: Altered methionine synthase reductase activity / B12 recycling
markers.interpretation: MTRR is responsible for maintaining MTR in its active cob(I)alamin state. The G allele reduces recycling efficiency, slightly raising cobalamin demands.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Modest effect size; easily countered with adequate dietary cobalamin.

sources.name: MTRR A66G polymorphism and neural tube defect risk
sources.notes: Details MTRR-B12 biochemical interactions in one-carbon loops.

markers.impact: Altered transcobalamin-2 transport / B12 cellular uptake
markers.interpretation: TCN2 is the primary transport protein for B12 from blood into tissues. The G (Arg) allele reduces binding affinity, which can lead to lower cellular delivery of B12 despite normal serum B12 levels.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Serum B12 tests can hide cellular deficiency in G/G carriers.

sources.name: TCN2 Pro259Arg and serum transcobalamin levels
sources.notes: Shows reduction in active B12 transport capacity of the Arg isoform.

markers.impact: Non-secretor status / lower serum vitamin B12 levels
markers.interpretation: FUT2 controls the secretion of ABH blood group antigens into body fluids. Homozygous A/A results in 'non-secretor' status, which alters gut microbiome composition and is strongly linked to lower circulating serum B12 levels.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Lower serum B12 in non-secretors does not always reflect intracellular deficiency.

sources.name: FUT2 secretor status and serum B12 levels
sources.notes: GWAS showing FUT2 locus is a major contributor to serum B12 variance.

markers.impact: Reduced phosphatidylcholine synthesis / elevated choline demand
markers.interpretation: PEMT synthesizes phosphatidylcholine in the liver. The T (Met) allele reduces enzyme activity, making carriers highly susceptible to choline deficiency, fatty liver (NAFLD), and muscle damage on low-choline diets.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Estrogens stimulate PEMT; premenopausal females have some protection unless they also carry MTHFR/MTHFD1 modifiers.

sources.name: PEMT polymorphisms and choline dietary requirements
sources.notes: Seminal nutritional genomics paper detailing dietary choline starvation responses.

markers.impact: Altered folate pathway enzymes / elevated choline requirement
markers.interpretation: MTHFD1 rs2236225 regulates a trifunctional folate enzyme. The A (His) allele impairs folate-mediated one-carbon flow, increasing dependence on the alternative choline-dependent (BHMT) pathway in the liver.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Works synergistically with PEMT and MTHFR variants to compound choline demand.

sources.name: MTHFD1 variants and choline/folate requirements
sources.notes: Replicates elevated fatty liver susceptibility on low-choline diets.

markers.impact: Altered Vitamin D receptor structural transcription
markers.interpretation: The FokI T (f) allele creates a longer, slightly less active VDR protein isoform. T-carriers may require slightly higher vitamin D3 levels to achieve comparable transcription of downstream target genes.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: VDR function requires binding of active calcitriol and partner RXR receptors; cofactor status is critical.

sources.name: VDR FokI and bone mineral density
sources.notes: Shows structural differences in VDR protein isoforms.

markers.interpretation: BsmI is an intronic polymorphism that acts as a proxy for VDR expression level variations. The A (b) allele is frequently linked in association studies to lower VDR density.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Strongly in linkage disequilibrium with TaqI and ApaI; haplotype analyses are more informative.

sources.name: VDR intronic polymorphisms and VDR expression
sources.notes: Examines expression markers associated with BsmI alleles.

markers.impact: Reduced Vitamin D-binding protein / lower circulating D3
markers.interpretation: GC encodes Vitamin D-binding protein (DBP). The C allele is associated with lower DBP levels and is the most robust GWAS locus driving reduced circulating serum 25(OH)D levels in the population.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Free (unbound) Vitamin D levels can remain stable even when total DBP-bound Vitamin D drops.

sources.name: GWAS of vitamin D insufficiency
sources.notes: Identifies GC, DHCR7, and CYP2R1 as primary circulating vitamin D regulators.

markers.interpretation: CYP2R1 is the primary liver enzyme that converts Vitamin D3 into circulating 25(OH)D. The A allele reduces enzyme activity, leading to less efficient conversion of dietary or sun-derived D3.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Easily countered with direct Vitamin D3 oral supplementation.

sources.name: GWAS of vitamin D insufficiency
sources.notes: Details the CYP2R1 liver conversion enzyme locus.

markers.impact: Impaired skin synthesis of pre-vitamin D3
markers.interpretation: DHCR7 converts 7-dehydrocholesterol to cholesterol, regulating the precursor pool for Vitamin D3 synthesis in the skin. The T allele is linked to reduced efficiency in synthesizing vitamin D3 from UVB light.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Irrelevant for individuals who obtain their Vitamin D from direct supplementation.

sources.name: GWAS of vitamin D insufficiency
sources.notes: Examines the DHCR7/NADSYN1 gene locus on chromosome 11.
